Receive CORRA H27 remains the concentrated book. Cash CORRA 2.29 versus H27 3.06 still prices about 77bp of hikes into a six-month window while CA labor 42.16 is cooling and Brent eased to ~$98 on a conditional Hormuz reopen plus Saudi Petroline restart. Long duration is working (entry 3.13 to 3.06) and still has residual edge. Barkin/Fed hike-spillover is the main risk, not a reason to cut a valid receive. Skip AUDCAD: RBA hikes are already priced and AU housing is correcting.

invalidation: Close if BoC delivers or explicitly endorses a 2027 path consistent with CRAH27 holding at or above the 3.13 entry, or if Canada CPI-trim/median leave the packet 1.9/2.0 zone higher while employment/wages reverse the August -42k / +2.0% cooling. Close if CRAH27 implied rises toward CRAM27 3.365 rather than cheapening. A US-only SOFR selloff that leaves CORRA_2027-03 unchanged is not invalidation. Energy headlines without a core/labor break are not invalidation. No hedge: if the thesis fails, close.
